description: Java source code for the ForegroundDispatch activity, demonstrating use of NFC foreground dispatch APIs in Android.

classes.name: ForegroundDispatch
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating NFC foreground dispatch setup and handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI, NFC adapter, intent filter for NDEF dispatch, and tech list for NfcF.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Enables NFC foreground dispatch when activity resumes.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new NFC tag intents and updates UI with discovered tag info.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Disables NFC foreground dispatch when activity pauses.
